============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v26.13.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    825 ns | 1,212,788 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1220 ns | 819,936 | 341 | 1.48x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2114 ns | 473,099 | 341 | 2.56x slower |
| google-protobuf |   4339 ns | 230,472 | 341 | 5.26x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3323 ns | 300,977 | 622 | 4.03x slower |
| JSON |   1504 ns | 664,803 | 791 | 1.82x slower |
